description: This file contains functions for installing and upgrading the Advanced OpenSales module in the SuiteCRM project, including configuration setup, database updates, and file management operations.

methods.name: install_aos
methods.description: Initializes configuration settings for the Advanced OpenSales module, setting default values and saving them to a configuration file.

methods.name: upgrade_aos
methods.description: Performs upgrade routines for the Advanced OpenSales module, including database updates and migration of old files to backup locations.
